title: Warmly Roasted Mediterranean Brussels Sprouts Skewers
description: A savory and snappy Mediterranean dish featuring roasted Brussels sprouts, perfect for a low-calorie friendly meal or snack. This dish is energizing and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the Brussels sprouts onto skewers, leaving a little space between each sprout.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the skewered Brussels sprouts to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the Brussels sprouts out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and sprinkle with feta cheese, parsley, and pomegranate seeds.
Drizzle the balsamic vinegar over the top of the Brussels sprouts.
Return the Brussels sprouts to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
